name: Eradicate (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 14

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can utterly destroy objects and constructs she breaks, leaving no evidence. When she reduces an object or construct to 0 hit points, she can choose to reduce it to dust, as if affected by disintegrate. This cannot be used on artifacts.
